notes.title: CLICK SPACE MINER 2 is now available
notes.content:
CLICK SPACE MINER 2 is out now and Free to play! Test it NOW



[b]In Click Space Miner II you take control over a mining company in space. There is a big market, a lot of customers, but therefore also a lot of concurrents so you have to mine fast. 
Click fast to get rich. Mine resources with your mouse fast and buy new tools and machines to do the work for you. Earn more and more money and get rich. But while mining and keeping track of the high management expenses, dont forget to renew your mining licenses because they are very popular and if you come too late you lose everything.
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061260/Click_Space_Miner_2/

notes.title: Patch 1.7 Out now
notes.content:
Hello fans

Today Patch 1.7 comes out for you. And I'm happy to announce some new features.
First of all thank you for playing thanks for your loyalty.
So CSM now has a 120hz support and can be played with full 120FPS. As well as the EXPANSION PACK.

In addition, now the SteamCloud is activated so your SAVEGAMES is secured and you should change the PC you can continue any time!

Many Thanks

Your CSM team

notes.title: Patch 1.4 with Savegame!
notes.content:
Hello Fans. 

Today, there are again a small Update for you.
In order to improve the game fun. I've added a Savegame. It saves automatically when you leave the game, or presses the ESC key.

Press a at the "Start" to start a new game. And Presses "continue" to your Savegame.


Patch note 1.4

- Savegame added
- New Menu
-Better textur size
- New button
